notes: Storefront decorations (user's decision 2026-11-14, proposal E): bought once, stand outside the store and only change how it looks.
They do not change visitors, sales or reputation (the user chose looks only). The trees and the planter are painted; the banners are the same simple style as the lunch-box banner already outside.
Each item has a list of places along the entrance side (tiles from the door span or from the far end) and a depth from the wall; the first place that is clear of the other street furniture is used.
